name: probanda
description: Probanda, Claude Cowork plugins for legal practice in British Columbia

plugins.name: practice
plugins.description: The base plugin: firm records, time, billing, filing, case data and deadlines. Requires nothing. Install it first: every other Probanda plugin requires it.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: What the law is: legal research, citation and verification. Requires practice. Install practice first, then research.

plugins.name: litigator
plugins.description: Court work on a matter: applying the law to the facts, drafting, court forms and filing packages. Requires practice and research. Install practice, then research, then litigator.

plugins.name: solicitor
plugins.description: Reserved for solicitor's work. Ships no skills yet. Requires practice. Install practice first.
